notes.title: Patch 0.3.87
notes.notes:
Added:

 Added the option to press an abilites keybind again to confirm the cast position for ground abilities


Updated:

 Improved AI attack logic


Fixed:

 Fixed attack and movement animations overriding each other

notes.title: Patch 0.3.84 - 0.3.86
notes.notes:
Fixes: 

Fixed game modes only working properly for the host,

Fixed actionbar ability order not being saved to the loadout,

Fixed pet looking hostile to the player,

Fixed pet kills not being credited to their owner which broke score tracking,

Fixed game mode logic being broken on several game modes,

Fixed mana being spent multiple times in a single ability cast,

Fixed auto attack trying to attack a dead target,

Fixed suicide command killing all players in the match instead of your own character

notes.title: Patch 0.3.83
notes.notes:
New:
- Switched from action targeting to tab targeting
- Added a button to collapse the death recap side panel
- Added frames to display teammates health buffs and debuffs.
- Reintroduced the Innervate spell which allows the caster to restore mana to any target

Updated:
- Made stat tooltips more descriptive
- Made projectiles fire parallel to the ground rather than in the direction of the camera to better accomodate for the tab targeting playstyle

Balancing:
- Brought back mana to help with balancing
- True Damage no longer crits
- Defensive Shell is no longer upgradeable
- Fluxbolt is now a targeted skill
- Fluxbolt range is now 15 down from 35

Fixes:
- Fixed kills being counted twice in some cases, causing matches to end faster than expected
- Fixed Out of bounds not killing players
- Fixed pet buff not being removed when the pet dies
- Fixed Protection aura not being castable
- Fixed auto attacks getting locked when you select their connected stat nodes
- Fixed some abilities being upgradeable that shouldn't have been
- Fixed some tooltips on the talent page
- Fixed Scoreboard not resetting after a match
- Fixed damage numbers from old targets showing up on the target frame when you switch targets
- Fixed projectiles colliding with allies that are meant to hit enemies
- Fixed health and mana regen calculation

notes.title: Patch 0.3.82
notes.notes:
New:
- Added Cleanse to the new talent tree
- Added Ignite to the new talent tree
- Barrier amount now shows on nameplates

Updated:
- Paladin default loadout to differentiate it from Warrior better
- Changed Cleanse to be a targeted spell
- Dodgeball skills are a 5 second cooldown
- Dodgeball skills can be casted while moving

Balancing:
- Increased Resistance nodes from 10% to 15% per node
- Reduced Cleanse cooldown from 60 seconds to 30 seconds
- Reduced Ignite cooldown from 60 seconds to 30 seconds
- Reduced Sprint cooldown from 60 seconds to 30 seconds
- Reduced Sprint applied speed from 5 to 3
- Reduced Defensive Bulwark applied Resistance from 10% to 5%
- Increased Defensive Bulwark applied Block Chance from 0% to 25%

Fixed:
- Stacking status effects not stacking
- Aura behavior when two players have the same aura
- Auras failing to cast and leaving the player stuck in a casting animation
- Auras not removing when the caster walks away
- Boost aura targeting enemies instead of allies
- Players spawning in as all character models
- Mouse look speed default value will now be set to 1 instead of 0
- Settings in the settings window not saving

notes.title: Patch 0.3.81
notes.notes:
New:
- Brand new talents page going for a more traditional tree style setup
- Added the new auto attack option Fluxbolt which is a piercing auto that hurts enemies and heals allies
- Added an abilities level to their tooltip
- Added self cast modifier keybind
- Added mouse look speed setting

Updated:
- Settings menu visuals
- Brought back Scythe spell with the new talent tree
- Brought back Barrier spell with the new talent tree

Balancing:
- Reduced Defensive Shell Ability Power per attribute point from 3 to 2
- Reduced Defensive Shell base barrier from 100 to 50
- Reduced Bind cast time from 0.5s to 0s
- Converted Bind to a projectile
- Increased Bind cast range from 25 to 35
- Increased Fireball cast range from 25 to 35
- Increased Barrage cast range from 25 to 35
- Increased Binding Shot cast range from 25 to 35
- Increased Piercing Arrow cast range from 25 to 35
- Increased Serrated Arrow cast range from 25 to 35
- Increased Thunderstorm Ability Power per attribute point from 1 to 1.5
- Made Burning Rage expend its health cost over the duration of the buff

Fixed:
- Team Deathmatch not ending the match when a team wins
- Piercing projectiles applying twice
- Pet not retaliating when attacked
- Cursor size on macOS

notes.title: Patch 0.3.77 - 0.3.80
notes.notes:
New:
- Added an ability to the Rogue specialization Summon Bear

Updated:
- Hide duplicate aura buff icon on player nameplates
- Apply button on settings window now closes the window

Fixed:
- Players hostility layers not being set properly
- Actionbar keybinds not updating when changed in the settings during gameplay

Balance:
- Increased all auto attack Ability Power scaling to 1 instead of 0.75
- Increased Ability Power per attribute point from 1.5 to 2
- Increased Crit Chance per attribute point to from 5 to 10
- Reduced allowed Crit Chance attribute points from 10 to 5
- Reduced allowed Block Chance attribute points from 5 to 3
- Reduced Max Health per attribute point from 30 to 25
- Reduced default Max Health from 500 to 300

Other:
- Cleaned up the project files and repository

notes.title: Patch 0.3.52 - 0.3.76
notes.notes:
Notes:

 way too much was done in these updates to have detailed patch notes, the entire network framework was overhauled to better integrate with the game engine.

New:

 some of the classes might work slightly differently now

Updated:

 finished porting to the new network framework

Fixed:

 tons of bugs, I lost track

notes.title: Patch: 0.3.51
notes.notes:
New:
- added "Playing" section to the friends list to show friends currently playing Crusaders Arena
- added counter to each section header in friends list
- added display for total stat amount based on your attribute point allocations on the loadouts page
- enabled pressing "Enter" on your keyboard in the loadout name field to create a new loadout

Updated:
- updated connecting background to new splash art
- various UI cleanup
- enabled block chance stat on loadout page again
- rename Crit Effectiveness to Crit Multiplier since it's a little more straightforward
- updated auto attack ability icons
- reduced auto attack ability power modifiers to 0.75 from 1
- adjusted several attribute max points and stat per point amounts

Fixed:
- fixed an issue with utility spell damage
- fixed block chance stat being inconsistent across clients
- fixed crit chance and block chance calculations
- fixed other various errors
